faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICGEB Research Associate-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICGEB Research Associate-1 position is 10-08-2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-1 post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree. Alternatively, 3 years of research, teaching, and industrial experience after an ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in a peer-reviewed journal is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate-1 position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-1 post primarily involves an application review. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their submitted applications and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for the ICGEB Research Associate-1 job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to prepare their application and send it to the official email address provided by ICGEB.

faq.question: Q6. What specific experience is mandatory for the Research Associate-1 role?
faq.answer: Mandatory experience includes handling algal strains. Additionally, knowledge of omics biology and photobioreactors is also required for this position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate-1 post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate-1 position in the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Research Associate-1 position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate-1 position is contract-based. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICGEB located?
faq.answer: ICGEB has a center in New Delhi, located at P.O. Box 10501, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi - 110067.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply after the last date?
faq.answer: No, applications submitted after the last date of 10-08-2026 will not be considered. It is crucial to ensure your application reaches the designated email address before the deadline.
